# Contract: Video Library

*Generated by spec-writer. Hand edits are overwritten on regeneration.*

## Prerequisites

These conditions describe the environment in which items in this
contract are exercised. Producing them is part of the feature's
deliverable, alongside the implementation itself — a contract whose
prerequisites are not yet satisfied is not failing, it is still being
built. Once the feature is delivered, any missing condition halts item
execution until it is restored.

**Runtime services:**
- the backend HTTP service (`apps/backend`) is running, migrated against its PostgreSQL database, and reachable
- the `apps/web` Next.js application is running (dev server or production build) and reachable by a browser, with its proxy Route Handlers able to reach the backend service
- a browser (or browser-automation engine) is available to drive UI and E2E items

**Persistent state:**
- a user exists with name "Existing User", email "existing@example.com", and password "ValidPass123" (the same fixture account established by the Authentication System feature), not suspended, not an admin. Used by: every item in this contract.
- a video titled "Sample Lecture" exists, owned by the existing user, with status `ready`, description "A sample lecture.", and a stored video file plus a stored thumbnail file on disk. Used by: API-LIST-01, API-RENAME-01, API-RENAME-02, API-RENAME-03, API-DESCRIBE-01, API-DESCRIBE-02, API-DELETE-01, API-DELETE-02, API-DELETE-03, UI-LIST-01, UI-RENAME-01, UI-RENAME-02, UI-DESCRIBE-01, UI-DELETE-01, UI-DELETE-02, E2E-RENAME-01, E2E-DELETE-01.
- five additional videos exist, all owned by the existing user, one in each processing status, uploaded in this chronological order (oldest to newest): "Echo Clip" (`failed`), "Charlie Clip" (`summarizing`), "Alpha Clip" (`validating`), "Delta Clip" (`ready`), "Bravo Clip" (`transcribing`). Used by: API-LIST-02, API-LIST-03, API-LIST-04, UI-STATUS-01.

**Static inputs:**
- `video-samples/tiny-valid.mp4` — the same small (a few seconds, well under 1MB) valid MP4 fixture established by the Video Upload feature; its content backs the "Sample Lecture" video's stored file, so its removal is directly verifiable. Used by: API-DELETE-01, E2E-DELETE-01.

**Configuration:**
- the frontend recognizes a cookie named `videomax_session` (any non-empty value) as an "authenticated visitor" signal, per the Authentication System feature. Used by: every UI and E2E item.
- the backend's session-signing key is configured and stable for the duration of a run. Used by: every item (all resolve a session to authenticate).
- the frontend's internal backend base URL is configured and points at the running backend service. Used by: every UI and E2E item, since all of them traverse the proxy.
- the backend's local-disk storage root is configured and points at a writable directory for the duration of a run. Used by: API-DELETE-01, API-DELETE-03, E2E-DELETE-01.
- a user's `libraryViewMode` defaults to `"grid"` when no value has been explicitly set. Used by: UI-VIEWTOGGLE-01.

**External dependencies:**
- the storage gateway used in tests supports a configurable failure mode for its delete operation, following this project's existing fake-gateway convention (e.g. the Video Upload feature's configurable-failure thumbnail fake). Used by: API-DELETE-03.

## Quality gates

Each gate must pass for the feature to be considered ready.

- **Backend architecture audit** — `npm run gates` — the consolidated backend check (TypeScript compiles with no errors, ESLint reports no errors, dependency-cruiser reports no forbidden cross-layer imports, the structural architecture check passes, madge reports no circular imports, knip reports no orphaned files/exports) succeeds as a whole.
- **Backend tests** — `npm run test --workspace apps/backend` — the Vitest suite (domain, use case, and handler tests) passes.
- **Backend build** — `npm run build --workspace apps/backend` — the TypeScript production build completes without errors.
- **Frontend lint** — `npm run lint --workspace apps/web` — ESLint reports no errors across the frontend app.
- **Frontend typecheck** — `npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web` — TypeScript compiles with no type errors (`tsc --noEmit`).
- **Frontend unit/component tests** — `npm run test --workspace apps/web` — the Vitest + React Testing Library suite passes.
- **Frontend end-to-end tests** — `npm run test:e2e --workspace apps/web` — the Playwright suite passes against a running build.
- **Frontend build** — `npm run build --workspace apps/web` — the Next.js production build completes without errors.

## Coverage Manifest

| PRD Acceptance Criterion | Covered by |
|---|---|
| Library at `/app` lists every video owned by the authenticated user | API-LIST-01, UI-LIST-01 |
| User can switch between grid and list view; the choice persists across sessions | API-VIEWMODE-01, UI-VIEWTOGGLE-01, UI-VIEWTOGGLE-02, E2E-VIEWMODE-01 |
| Each card shows the current processing status (validating, transcribing, summarizing, ready, or failed) | UI-STATUS-01 |
| User can rename a video's title to any non-empty string of 1–200 characters | API-RENAME-01, API-RENAME-03, UI-RENAME-01 |
| User can edit a video's description up to 2000 characters | API-DESCRIBE-01, API-DESCRIBE-02, UI-DESCRIBE-01 |
| Renaming to an empty string is rejected inline | API-RENAME-02, UI-RENAME-02 |
| Deleting a video opens a confirmation modal whose Delete button is disabled for 1 second after opening | UI-DELETE-01 |
| Confirming deletion permanently removes the video file, thumbnail, transcription, summary, and any folder or tag associations | API-DELETE-01, UI-DELETE-02, E2E-DELETE-01 |
| Empty library shows an illustration and the upload zone | UI-EMPTY-01 |
| Video metadata and thumbnail provided by upload (F03) render correctly in the library grid and list views (F04), including title, description, duration, upload date, file size, and current processing status | API-LIST-01, UI-LIST-01 |

## HTTP API

**Verification mode:** Send an HTTP request to the running backend service; assert response status, headers, body, and any direct persisted side-effect.

### List

**Common given:** the backend is running with default configuration; the existing user is authenticated.

#### `API-LIST-01` — lists the authenticated user's videos with full metadata
- given: (default), and the "Sample Lecture" video belongs to the existing user
- when: GET /videos
- then:
  - response is `200` and `items` includes an entry with `{ id, title: "Sample Lecture", description: "A sample lecture.", status: "ready", thumbnailUrl: non-null, sizeBytes, durationSeconds, uploadedAt }`
  - `total` equals the number of videos belonging to this user

#### `API-LIST-02` — default order is most recent first
- given: (default), and the five status-fixture videos exist
- when: GET /videos (no `sort` param)
- then:
  - response is `200` with `items` ordered by title: Bravo Clip, Delta Clip, Alpha Clip, Charlie Clip, Echo Clip (newest upload first)

#### `API-LIST-03` — sort=oldest orders by oldest upload first
- given: (default), and the five status-fixture videos exist
- when: GET /videos?sort=oldest
- then:
  - response is `200` with `items` ordered by title: Echo Clip, Charlie Clip, Alpha Clip, Delta Clip, Bravo Clip (oldest upload first)

#### `API-LIST-04` — sort=title orders alphabetically
- given: (default), and the five status-fixture videos exist
- when: GET /videos?sort=title
- then:
  - response is `200` with `items` ordered by title: Alpha Clip, Bravo Clip, Charlie Clip, Delta Clip, Echo Clip

### Rename

**Common given:** the backend is running with default configuration; the "Sample Lecture" video belongs to the authenticated existing user.

#### `API-RENAME-01` — happy path renames the title
- given: (default)
- when: PATCH /videos/{id of "Sample Lecture"} with body `{ title: "Sample Lecture (final cut)" }`
- then:
  - response is `200` with body `{ id, title: "Sample Lecture (final cut)" }`
  - the video is persisted with the new title

#### `API-RENAME-02` — empty or whitespace-only title rejected
- given: (default)
- when: PATCH /videos/{id} with body `{ title: "   " }`
- then:
  - response is `422` with `code: "INVALID_TITLE"`
  - the video's persisted title is unchanged

#### `API-RENAME-03` — title over 200 characters rejected
- given: (default)
- when: PATCH /videos/{id} with a 201-character `title`
- then:
  - response is `422` with `code: "INVALID_TITLE"`
  - the video's persisted title is unchanged

### Description

**Common given:** the backend is running with default configuration; the "Sample Lecture" video belongs to the authenticated existing user.

#### `API-DESCRIBE-01` — happy path updates the description
- given: (default)
- when: PATCH /videos/{id} with body `{ description: "Covers attention and positional encodings." }`
- then:
  - response is `200` with body `{ id, description: "Covers attention and positional encodings." }`
  - the video is persisted with the new description

#### `API-DESCRIBE-02` — description over 2000 characters rejected
- given: (default)
- when: PATCH /videos/{id} with a 2001-character `description`
- then:
  - response is `422` with `code: "DESCRIPTION_TOO_LONG"`
  - the video's persisted description is unchanged

### Delete

**Common given:** the backend is running with default configuration; the "Sample Lecture" video belongs to the authenticated existing user, with a stored video file and a stored thumbnail file on disk.

#### `API-DELETE-01` — happy path permanently removes the video, its file, and its thumbnail
- given: (default)
- when: DELETE /videos/{id}
- then:
  - response is `204`
  - a subsequent GET /videos no longer includes this video
  - the stored video file at its storage key no longer exists
  - the stored thumbnail file no longer exists

#### `API-DELETE-02` — deleting an already-deleted video
- given: (default), and this video was already deleted once
- when: DELETE /videos/{id} again
- then:
  - response is `404` with `code: "VIDEO_NOT_FOUND"`

#### `API-DELETE-03` — the row is removed even when the underlying file deletion fails
- given: (default), and the storage gateway's delete operation is armed to fail for this video
- when: DELETE /videos/{id}
- then:
  - response is `204`
  - a subsequent GET /videos no longer includes this video

### View mode

**Common given:** the backend is running with default configuration; the existing user is authenticated.

#### `API-VIEWMODE-01` — setting the view mode persists it on the account
- given: (default)
- when: PATCH /auth/me/library-view-mode with body `{ viewMode: "list" }`
- then:
  - response is `200` with body `{ libraryViewMode: "list" }`
  - a subsequent GET /auth/me returns `libraryViewMode: "list"`

#### `API-VIEWMODE-02` — an invalid view mode is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: PATCH /auth/me/library-view-mode with body `{ viewMode: "timeline" }`
- then:
  - response is `422` with `code: "INVALID_LIBRARY_VIEW_MODE"`
  - a subsequent GET /auth/me still returns the account's prior `libraryViewMode`

## UI

**Verification mode:** Render the surface, drive it with user-like inputs (clicks, typing); assert observable surface state (DOM, visible text, timing).

### List and status

**Common given:** a user is logged in (a valid `videomax_session` cookie, reached through `/login`) on `/app`.

#### `UI-LIST-01` — library renders every video with its metadata
- given: (default), and the "Sample Lecture" video belongs to the user
- when: the library page loads
- then:
  - a card/row for "Sample Lecture" is visible showing its title, duration, an upload date/size readout, and a status badge
  - the extracted thumbnail is visible (not the default placeholder image)

#### `UI-STATUS-01` — every processing status renders its own badge
- given: (default), and the five status-fixture videos (one each in `validating`, `transcribing`, `summarizing`, `ready`, `failed`) belong to the user
- when: the library page loads
- then:
  - a card/row exists for each of the five videos
  - each card/row's badge text matches its own status ("Validating", "Transcribing", "Summarizing", "Ready", "Failed")

### View toggle

#### `UI-VIEWTOGGLE-01` — switching to list view changes the layout
- given: a user is logged in on `/app`; at least one video exists; the view mode is currently `grid`
- when: click the list-view toggle
- then:
  - the video list re-renders as compact rows (list-specific columns are visible)
  - the grid card layout is no longer shown

#### `UI-VIEWTOGGLE-02` — a previously saved view mode is applied on load
- given: a user is logged in on `/app`; the user's `libraryViewMode` is currently `list`; at least one video exists
- when: the library page loads
- then:
  - the video list renders in the compact row layout without any manual toggle click

### Rename

**Common given:** a user is logged in on `/app`; the "Sample Lecture" video belongs to the user.

#### `UI-RENAME-01` — inline rename happy path
- given: (default)
- when: open the video's context menu, choose rename, clear the field, type "Sample Lecture (final cut)", and confirm
- then:
  - the card/row now shows "Sample Lecture (final cut)" as its title

#### `UI-RENAME-02` — renaming to an empty string is rejected inline
- given: (default)
- when: open the video's context menu, choose rename, clear the field, and confirm
- then:
  - an inline message reads "Title cannot be empty"
  - the card/row still shows the original title

### Description

**Common given:** a user is logged in on `/app`; the "Sample Lecture" video belongs to the user.

#### `UI-DESCRIBE-01` — edit description happy path
- given: (default)
- when: open the video's context menu, choose "Edit description", type "Covers attention and positional encodings.", and save
- then:
  - the modal closes
  - re-opening "Edit description" shows the saved text in the textarea

### Delete

**Common given:** a user is logged in on `/app`; the "Sample Lecture" video belongs to the user.

#### `UI-DELETE-01` — the Delete button is disabled for one second after the modal opens
- given: (default)
- when: open the video's context menu and choose delete
- then:
  - the confirmation modal shows "Delete 'Sample Lecture'? This cannot be undone."
  - its Delete button is disabled immediately after the modal opens
  - the Delete button becomes enabled after about one second
- notes: verify the enabled transition within roughly 1-1.5s of the modal opening

#### `UI-DELETE-02` — confirming deletion removes the card from the list
- given: (default)
- when: open the delete confirmation modal, wait for the Delete button to enable, and click Delete
- then:
  - the modal closes
  - the video's card/row is no longer present in the list

### Empty state

#### `UI-EMPTY-01` — empty library shows the illustration and the upload zone
- given: a user is logged in on `/app` with no videos
- when: the library page loads
- then:
  - the text "Upload your first video to get started" is visible
  - the upload drop zone is visible

## E2E

**Verification mode:** Run the full system (frontend + backend + database); drive through a real browser; assert cross-stack behavior.

### Rename

#### `E2E-RENAME-01` — rename persists across reload
- given: a user is logged in on `/app`; the "Sample Lecture" video belongs to the user
- when: rename it to "Sample Lecture (final cut)" through the UI, then reload the browser
- then:
  - after reload, the video still shows the new title
  - the video's persisted title in the database matches the new title

### Delete

#### `E2E-DELETE-01` — delete persists across reload
- given: a user is logged in on `/app`; the "Sample Lecture" video belongs to the user, with a stored video file and thumbnail on disk
- when: delete it through the UI, then reload the browser
- then:
  - after reload, the video's card is no longer present
  - no video row exists in the database with that id
  - the stored video file no longer exists on disk

### View mode

#### `E2E-VIEWMODE-01` — view mode persists across logout and login
- given: a user is logged in on `/app` with at least one video; the view mode is currently `grid`
- when: switch to list view, log out, then log back in
- then:
  - after logging back in, the library renders in list view without any manual toggle
